config.notes: Ara Institute of Canterbury (NZ, NZD). All course pages are on www.ara.ac.nz/products/programme/<code>-<ref>-<slug>/ (not the Te Pukenga domain); server-rendered, no page JSON. Intakes: dated class list ("Start date: 15 February 2027") plus "International application close date 6 January for February start; 2 June for July start"; no term names, so no term_months. Central calendar https://www.ara.ac.nz/about-us/academic-calendar/ (2026: Semester 1 starts 16 February, Semester 2 starts 20 July). Fee: "Fees for 2026 Domestic Fee ... International Fee $26,572 per year" (international, labelled per year; 19-week programmes print a one-semester amount, $13,286, as per year - exclude those). IELTS: "IELTS 6.0 Academic 5.5 Listening 5.5 Reading ..." in entry requirements; the Listening band is required so registration notes (SWRB IELTS 7.0) are skipped. No central numeric English rule: https://www.ara.ac.nz/study/priority-learner-groups/international/international-how-to-apply/academic-equivalence/ defers to course pages. Campus: "Campus Location City campus, Christchurch" (few pages). Duration/mode: "Programme Duration Full-time - 3 Years". study_level = Information Type. aqf_level holds the NZQF level ("Credits 360 Level 7"), not AQF.
